# Historical synthetic regression inputs

Owner: system tests. These formerly user-facing examples are retained for unit,
Blender integration, recognition regression and historical validation links.
The three current tutorials live under `examples/`.

Each subfolder retains its original generator and provenance. Do not remove files
referenced by tests, `tools/smoke_render.py` or historical validation documents.
New test runs belong in ignored `artifacts/` or temporary workspaces, not here.
